reason: Counterexample. The oscillating sequence u_k(x) = (1/k) w(kx) has |u_k'| = 1 and converges weakly in H^1 to 0, while int ((u')^2-1)^2 vanishes along the sequence and equals 1 at the limit; the double-well gradient integrand is nonconvex, so the convexity hypothesis of the weak-lower-semicontinuity lemma is essential. Sources [MA] Chapter 2 Section 4 (Theorems 2.46-2.50, Example 2.54) and [T] Example 13.6.
